## Validation

- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run validate`
- [ ] Changed skill packaged and archive inspected
- [ ] Standard Skills CLI project install tested
- [ ] Cursor and Claude Code payloads compared
- [ ] Fixtures contain fictional data only
- [ ] No credentials, IDs, owner emails, live URLs, private paths, or generated reports
- [ ] External mutations and production actions remain human-gated
- [ ] Official frontmatter, `VERSION`, `catalog.json`, changelog, and tag agree
- [ ] External template tag resolves to the locked full commit SHA
